description:
Rank Czech savings accounts (spořicí účty) by the effective interest rate (úrok, sazba) for a given deposit, with the net yield after the 15 % tax.

The effective rate is computed for the WHOLE amount: many banks pay their headline rate only up to a limit (e.g. Česká spořitelna 5,20 % only up to 400 000 Kč), so the ranking changes with the amount. Filters drop accounts with card-payment, income or new-money conditions, or keep only accounts without conditions.

Examples:
  - "Kam dát 800 000 Kč na spořicí účet?" -> amount=800000
  - "Nejvyšší úrok bez podmínek pro 1 milion" -> amount=1000000, no_conditions=true
Use hlidac_get_product for one account's bands and conditions, hlidac_plan_allocation to split a large sum across banks.

amount.description: Deposit in CZK (vklad v Kč), whole number 1 000–10 000 000, e.g. 800000

include_investment.description: Count the higher rate some banks pay with a regular investment

limit.description: How many accounts to return, best first

no_conditions.description: Only accounts with no conditions at all (spořicí účet bez podmínek)

without_card_payments.description: Exclude accounts that require card payments (bez placení kartou)

without_income_requirement.description: Exclude accounts that require a regular income (bez požadavku na příjem)

without_new_money.description: Exclude offers only for new money moved from another bank (bez nových peněz)

name: hlidac_compare_savings

effective_rate.description: % p. a. for the whole deposit (weighted over bands)

net_yield_year.description: CZK a year after the 15 % withholding tax

promo_until.description: End of the promotional rate (YYYY-MM-DD), null when none is stated

rate_basis.description: 'standard' for any client meeting the conditions, 'new_client' only for new money or a new client, 'promo' a promotion with an end

stale.description: true when verified more than 7 days ago

asOf.description: When the rates were last updated (ISO 8601)

title: Compare Czech savings accounts
